# Best chargers for charging many AA/AAA NiMH cells at once

For a lot of batteries at once, get a 16-bay charger. If 8 is enough, the Tenergy TN480U is the one option here I can give you a direct buy link for.

## 16-bay options

- **Tenergy TN438 16-Bay:** My pick if you want to see what each cell is doing. It charges any mix of AA and AAA NiMH/NiCd cells, with a large LCD showing the status of each cell. It also has protection against overcharge, overheating, short-circuit and reverse polarity, plus an 8-hour timer. ([Electronics Advisor](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-nimh-battery-charger/))
- **BONAI 16-Bay:** The most widely recommended in these reviews. Any slot takes AA or AAA, and the slots work independently. It plugs straight into the wall (110-240V) with no separate adapter. It delivers 250-500 mA per port, and LEDs show charging, full, or a faulty cell. It won't charge alkaline or lithium cells. ([Electronics Advisor](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-aa-battery-chargers/))
- **POWEROWL 16-Bay:** Also has 16 independent channels, a four-stage charge process (pre-charge, quick, float, trickle) and status LEDs. ([Electronics Advisor](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-aa-battery-chargers/))

The search results only gave me review pages for these, not direct purchase links, and no prices. The "Check Price on Amazon" buttons on those pages are the closest I can point you to. Check the current price and the listing's seller before you buy.

## 8-bay option with a direct link

**Tenergy TN480U 8-Bay, $23.99:** [Buy here](https://dealectric.com/go/tenergy-tn480u-8-bay-nimh-charger) (affiliate link, so Dealectric is paid if you buy).
- It takes mixed AA and AAA and charges at 500 mA per AA and 250 mA per AAA.
- It has a per-slot LCD and bad-cell detection.
- It runs on USB-C or Micro-USB at 5V/2A, and the power adapter is not included. On a weaker 1A source, five or more AA cells drop to 250 mA each.
- The source doesn't say whether each bay is fully independent. ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/answers/best-high-capacity-aa-aaa-nimh-battery-charger-8-bay-16-bay-independent-channels))

Dealectric says it has no 16-bay charger on record. That only reflects its own catalog, since the other sources list several 16-bay models.

## Which to choose

- **Most cells, best visibility:** Tenergy TN438.
- **Simplest wall-plug 16-bay:** BONAI 16-Bay.
- **Smaller, cheaper, with a link ready:** Tenergy TN480U, plus a 2A USB-C charger.

If you also need cells, the [Tenergy Premium PRO 2,800 mAh AA 20-pack ($42.99)](https://dealectric.com/go/tenergy-premium-pro-aa-2800mah-20-pack) pairs well with any of these. Some devices built strictly for 1.5V alkalines may read NiMH's 1.2V as low.
